_readme: REVIEW POLICY — read before collecting anything.
1. Nothing enters reviews.json by hand unless a real customer wrote it.
2. A review is only marked verified:true when it is matched to a completed
order in the database. Unmatched reviews stay verified:false.
3. A review is only published (published:true) after a human reads it and
confirms the customer gave permission to display it, with their name or
4. Never edit an average or a count directly. Both are computed from the
array at render time, so they cannot drift from the reviews listed.
5. If there are no published reviews, the site shows nothing rather than a
placeholder. That is correct behaviour, not a bug.
Collecting reviews: POST /api/review with JSON body { name, email, rating,
body, service, orderNumber? }. Email is stored for follow-up only and must
never be published. Submissions land in data/review-submissions.json as
published:false, and are promoted here individually after moderation.
